rationale:
I checked all three drafts against the final captures (assets/screens PNGs and their mark JSONs), the capture scripts and the campus-boundary data. None of them makes a forbidden claim in narration or misquotes UI copy. Every mark I spot-checked matches the JSONs, and every caption passes the mechanics, checked by script: no line over 41 characters, at most 2.57 words/s, no caption under 1.6 s, and 234, 223 and 212 words respectively. So the ranking comes down to subtler compliance problems and craft.

B-story wins. Its accuracy is the most thorough: it uses the final-run order IDs and the 7:24 pm prep time, quotes the app's own step footers, steers away from risky captures, and quotes the 'status timeline, not a rider on a map' line. It is also the only draft that names students, faculty and staff, which the facts allow, and its motion ties actions to results best: the address card docks into the Home header, the cuisine chips fly into the tabs, and the order lines dock into the cart. Its defects are small and easy to fix: two taps land after their results, the ₹ in the s08 hero numbers is set in Sora, and the picker push-ins magnify the app's 'SETU delivers inside...' subtitle.

A-tutorial is the best on honesty mechanics: a DEMO tag across the whole OTP portion, a TIME-LAPSE tag, and map framing that keeps the 'SETU delivers' subtitle out of frame. But its acknowledgement ring encloses 'Required. Recorded against your...' (I confirmed this on a crop of 41-step4-ack.png), one ADD tap jumps straight to '2', the ₹ is set in Sora in three scenes, and the copy reads like a manual right at the reading-speed limit.

C-value handles the ₹ glyph correctly and orders taps before results most faithfully. It loses ground on the 'PROVEN' stamps (a customer's cart cannot prove there is no commission), a demo note left on screen for about 90 s instead of once, and a 113.8 s runtime.

What to carry into B: from A, the DEMO tag across the whole OTP portion, the TIME-LAPSE tag, and the s 1.8 / focus y575 map framing (applied to B's picker shots as well). From C, ₹ set in Plus Jakarta Sans, taps placed before their results, and the Step 4 focus mask.

One build note: the default phone placement differs from STYLE.md ({left:1150, top:70, k:1.08}) in all three drafts, so it needs reconciling at build time.
